result.instructions: RevitCortex exposes hundreds of dedicated Revit tools. ALWAYS prefer the dedicated tool that matches the task (parameters, filtering/queries, model statistics, views, schedules, tags, dimensions, rebar, steel, IFC, Power BI). Destructive tools accept a dryRun option — preview before committing. send_code_to_revit is a LAST RESORT: never select it autonomously. Escalate to it only when no dedicated tool covers the operation (exotic geometry creation, read-only inspection of an uncovered Revit API, or a one-off operation no dedicated tool covers) — never for modal family editing (Document.EditFamily deadlocks from the external-event context) — and only after proposing the dedicated-tool alternative to the user and obtaining their explicit consent.

tools.name: create_text_note
tools.description: Create text notes in a view. Pass a JSON array: [{text, position:{x,y,z}, viewId?, textNoteTypeId?, width?, horizontalAlignment?, verticalAlignment?, rotation?, leader?}]. rotation is degrees; leader is left|right|leftArc|rightArc.

textNotes.description: JSON array of text note specs: [{text, position:{x,y,z}, viewId?, width?, horizontalAlignment?, verticalAlignment?, rotation?, leader?}]

tools.name: get_steel_material_links
tools.description: Report steel fabrication material links for an element. The Revit SDK does not expose linked-material enumeration on SteelElementProperties; this returns count 0 with a note.

tools.name: get_rebar_varying_data
tools.description: Read varying-length rebar state (Revit 2025+, read-only): canHaveVaryingLengthBars, varyingEnabled, and per-position centerline length (mm). Provide rebarId, optional includeBarLengths (default true). Returns a version error on older targets.

tools.name: list_rebar_fabric_types
tools.description: List fabric reinforcement types (fabric sheet types and fabric area types).

tools.name: set_element_workset
tools.description: Move elements to a different workset. Pass a JSON array of requests: [{elementId, worksetName}]. Worksets are resolved by name only.

tools.name: get_steel_connection_settings
tools.description: Read the document-wide StructuralConnectionSettings (currently exposes the IncludeWarningControls flag).

tools.name: list_steel_connection_types
tools.description: List StructuralConnectionType definitions in the document: id, name, family symbol id, applyTo. Use maxResults (default 100) and summaryOnly for counts-first browsing.

summaryOnly.description: Return only the total count, no per-type array. Default false

tools.name: set_steel_connection_type
tools.description: Change a structural connection's type. Revit exposes no in-place type setter, so this recreates the connection: it reads the connected elements, deletes the old handler, and creates a new one with connectionHandlerTypeId|connectionHandlerTypeName. Requires an installed connection provider/type. Supports dryRun. Existing input points are not preserved.

connectionId.description: Element id of the StructuralConnectionHandler to retype

connectionHandlerTypeId.description: Element id of the new StructuralConnectionHandlerType

connectionHandlerTypeName.description: Name of the new connection handler type (resolved against the document)

dryRun.description: Preview without recreating. Default: true (preview); set false to execute.

tools.name: set_material_properties
tools.description: Set identity, appearance, product info, and asset assignments on Revit materials. Each request is a FLAT object keyed by materialId plus any of: name, color (#RRGGBB), transparency, shininess, smoothness, materialClass, materialCategory, description, manufacturer, model, url, cost, mark, keynote, comments, appearanceAssetId, structuralAssetId, thermalAssetId (asset ids: 0/-1 clears).

requests.description: JSON array of flat requests, e.g. [{"materialId":123,"color":"#FF0000","appearanceAssetId":456}]

dryRun.description: Preview changes without applying. Default: true

tools.name: list_steel_connection_handlers
tools.description: List structural connection handlers in the document: id, type id/name, connected element count, custom/detailed flags. Use maxResults (default 100) and summaryOnly for counts-first browsing.

summaryOnly.description: Return only the total count, no per-handler array. Default false

tools.name: copy_elements
tools.description: Copy elements with optional mm offset. Can target a different view (sourceViewId+targetViewId) or another OPEN document (targetDocumentTitle).

elementIds.description: Element IDs to copy

sourceViewId.description: Source view ID (optional; required with targetViewId)

targetViewId.description: Target view ID (optional; required with sourceViewId)

targetDocumentTitle.description: Title of another open document to copy into (without .rvt). Omit for same-document copy

tools.name: delete_element
tools.description: Delete elements from the Revit project.

elementIds.description: Array of element IDs to delete

dryRun.description: Preview changes without applying

tools.name: get_materials
tools.description: List all materials in the active Revit document.

compact.description: Strip numeric appearance props (transparency/shininess/smoothness). Default: false

tools.name: sync_csv_parameters
tools.description: Synchronize parameter values from CSV data into Revit elements.

data.description: JSON array of rows: [{elementId, paramName1: value, paramName2: value, ...}]

dryRun.description: Preview changes without applying. Default: true

tools.name: set_rebar_terminations
tools.description: Set rebar end terminations (orientation/rotation). Revit 2026+ only; returns a version error on older targets. Provide rebarId, end (0|1), orientation, rotationDegrees.

tools.name: color_elements
tools.description: Color the active view's elements of a category by grouping them on a parameter value, or reset (clear) those color overrides. action=color|reset. Operates on the ACTIVE model view (not a sheet).

categoryName.description: Category name or OST_* code (e.g. OST_Walls, Doors)

parameterName.description: Parameter to group/color by (required for color), e.g. "Type Name", "Level"

action.description: Action: color | reset. Default: color

useGradient.description: Use a blue→red gradient across groups. Default: false (random colors)

customColors.description: Optional explicit colors as JSON array [{r,g,b}, ...], cycled across groups

tools.name: get_material_quantities
tools.description: Calculate material area and volume across elements, optionally filtered by category or restricted to the current selection.

selectedElementsOnly.description: Restrict to the current Revit selection. Default: false

maxElements.description: Cap on elements processed (default 20000). Above the cap the tool fails with a structured error instead of freezing Revit — narrow with categoryFilters/selectedElementsOnly or raise this deliberately.

tools.name: get_schedule_data
tools.description: Export schedule data as JSON from an existing schedule view.

maxRows.description: Maximum number of body rows to return. Default: 500

tools.name: rename_views
tools.description: Batch rename views using find/replace, prefix, or suffix operations.

tools.name: get_rebar_numbering
tools.description: Read rebar numbering. With rebarId returns that bar's schedule mark; without it returns every rebar's schedule mark plus the count of blank marks (a proxy for numbering gaps). The document-wide list is capped by maxResults (truncated/returnedCount flag a cut) and summaryOnly returns only the counts.

rebarId.description: Rebar element id (optional; category-wide if omitted)

maxResults.description: Max rebars to return in the document-wide list. Default 100

summaryOnly.description: Return only count + blankMarkCount, no per-rebar list. Default false

tools.name: remove_rebar_splice
tools.description: Remove a rebar splice at a bar end (Revit 2025+). Provide rebarId and optional barEnd (0 or 1; default 0). Returns a version error on older targets.

tools.name: manage_rebar_numbering
tools.description: Manage rebar numbering. action=set_number writes a single bar's schedule mark (needs rebarId + newNumber). action=renumber|remove_gaps are not exposed by the Revit API and return a structured 'unsupported' result. A read-only target surfaces the issue in warnings rather than failing.

action.description: Action: set_number | renumber | remove_gaps

tools.name: set_steel_connection_approval
tools.description: Set the approval type of a structural connection handler. Provide connectionId and approvalTypeId or approvalTypeName (verified against the document's StructuralConnectionApprovalType definitions).

approvalTypeId.description: Element id of the approval type to apply

approvalTypeName.description: Name of the approval type to apply (validated then matched by name)

dryRun.description: Preview without applying. Default: true (preview); set false to execute.

tools.name: duplicate_material
tools.description: Duplicate an existing material with a new name.

sourceMaterialId.description: Source material element ID (alternative to sourceMaterialName)

tools.name: get_selected_linked_elements
tools.description: Returns info about currently selected link instances.

tools.name: list_family_sizes
tools.description: List loaded families with type/instance counts and, when includeSize=true, the family file size in KB measured by exporting each family to a temp file. Disabled by default because exporting is slow on models with many families.

sortBy.description: Sort by: instanceCount | typeCount | name | sizeKB. Default: instanceCount. Note: sizeKB sort requires includeSize=true and forces size measurement on every family (slow on large models).

includeSize.description: If true, measure each returned family's file size in KB. Default false. Cost: ~50-200ms per family (one EditFamily + temp save round-trip).

tools.name: apply_view_template
tools.description: List, apply, or remove view templates from views. action=list|apply|remove.

action.description: Action: list | apply | remove. Default: apply

viewIds.description: View IDs to apply/remove template on

tools.name: unify_rebars
tools.description: Unify compatible standalone bars into one (Revit 2025+). Provide rebarIds (JSON array of >=2 ids); bars are unified pairwise into a single rebar. Returns a version error on older targets.

rebarIds.description: Rebar ids JSON array (>=2 ids, e.g. [123,456])

tools.name: set_rebar_shape
tools.description: Change the shape of a shape-driven rebar. Provide rebarId and shapeId or shapeName.

shapeName.description: Rebar shape name (used if shapeId omitted)

tools.name: set_rebar_coupler_visibility
tools.description: Set a coupler unobscured (solid) or obscured in a view. Provide couplerId, viewId, unobscured (bool).

tools.name: create_level
tools.description: Create, edit, rename, or delete a level. action=create|set|rename|delete. For set/rename/delete identify the level by levelId or name.

name.description: Level name (required for create; identifies the target for set/rename/delete when levelId is omitted)

elevation.description: Elevation in mm (create, or set to change an existing level's elevation)

action.description: Action: create | set | rename | delete. Default: create

levelId.description: Level element id (identifies the target for set/rename/delete)

dryRun.description: Preview changes without applying. Default: true

tools.name: analyze_structural_steel_model
tools.description: Document-wide structural steel summary: counts of connection handlers, connection types, connection handler types, approval types, and structural framing/column elements carrying SteelElementProperties. summaryOnly returns counts only; otherwise capped sample arrays via maxResults.

maxResults.description: Maximum items per sample array. Default 100

summaryOnly.description: Return only counts, no sample arrays. Default false

tools.name: operate_element
tools.description: Select, highlight, isolate, hide, or zoom to elements. Actions: select, selectionbox, setcolor, settransparency, hide, temphide, isolate, unhide, resetisolate, delete.

elementIds.description: Element IDs to operate on

action.description: Action to perform

tools.name: export_schedule
tools.description: Export schedule to CSV/TSV or JSON

format.description: Export format (csv, tsv, json). Default: csv

tools.name: create_rebar_coupler
tools.description: Create a rebar coupler connecting two bar ends, or cap one. Provide couplerTypeId or couplerTypeName (a Coupler-category family type), end1 (JSON {rebarId,end}) and optional end2 (JSON {rebarId,end}). 'end' is 0 or 1.

couplerTypeId.description: Coupler type id (a FamilySymbol of category OST_Coupler)

couplerTypeName.description: Coupler type name (used if couplerTypeId omitted)

end2.description: end2 JSON descriptor {rebarId,end} (omit to cap a single bar)

tools.name: ifc_compare_original_vs_rebuilt
tools.description: Compare volume/geometry between the original DirectShape and its native rebuild.

tools.name: delete_steel_connection
tools.description: Delete a structural connection handler by connectionId. Destructive — supports dryRun to preview. The connected elements themselves are not deleted.

connectionId.description: Element id of the StructuralConnectionHandler to delete

dryRun.description: Preview without deleting. Default: true (preview); set false to execute.

tools.name: set_compound_structure
tools.description: Modify compound structure on a wall/floor/roof/ceiling type. action=replace|add|remove|modify|set_wrapping. set_wrapping sets openingWrapping (none|exterior|interior|both), endCap (none|exterior|interior), and per-layer layerWrapping.

action.description: Action: replace | add | remove | modify | set_wrapping. Default: replace

layers.description: Layer definitions as JSON array for replace: [{function, materialName, widthMm}]

openingWrapping.description: Opening (insert) wrapping for set_wrapping: none | exterior | interior | both

endCap.description: End cap condition for set_wrapping: none | exterior | interior

layerWrapping.description: Per-layer wrapping for set_wrapping: JSON [{layerIndex, wraps:bool}]

dryRun.description: Preview changes without applying

tools.name: create_rebar_from_shape
tools.description: Create a shape-driven rebar in a host from a rebar shape. origin/xVec/yVec are JSON {x,y,z} in mm. Optional layout JSON.

shapeName.description: Rebar shape name (used if shapeId omitted)

barTypeName.description: Rebar bar type name (used if barTypeId omitted)

layout.description: Layout JSON {rule, number?, arrayLengthMm?, spacingMm?, barsOnNormalSide?, includeFirstBar?, includeLastBar?}

tools.name: manage_links
tools.description: List, reload, reload-from-path, unload, or remove linked files. To add a NEW link use add_linked_file instead.

action.description: Action to perform: list | reload | reload_from | unload | remove

newPath.description: New absolute path to reload the link from (required for reload_from)

tools.name: duplicate_schedule
tools.description: Duplicate a schedule with a new name

tools.name: get_worksets
tools.description: List all worksets in the active Revit document.

tools.name: propagate_rebar
tools.description: Propagate rebar to similar hosts. NOTE: the Revit API exposes no rebar-propagation method on any supported version; this returns a structured 'unsupported' result. Provide rebarId, optional targetHostIds JSON array.

targetHostIds.description: Optional target host ids JSON array (e.g. [123,456])

tools.name: get_elements_by_unique_id
tools.description: Resolve Revit UniqueId strings to ElementId records for cross-app workflows.

uniqueIds.description: Array of Revit UniqueId strings to resolve

tools.name: get_rebar_rounding
tools.description: Read rebar length-rounding rules. Without rebarId returns the document default; with rebarId returns that bar's effective rounding. Method is Nearest|Up|Down. There is no volume rounding in the Revit API.

rebarId.description: Rebar element id (optional; document default if omitted)

tools.name: ifc_set_family_mapping_file
tools.description: Set the family mapping file used by subsequent IFC exports.

filePath.description: Path to the family mapping .txt file

tools.name: pbi_get_binding
tools.description: Returns the Power BI ProjectBinding stored for the active Revit document (workspaceId, datasetId, datasetName, docKey, updatedAt). Returns bound=false with a tip if no binding exists yet. Read-only — call this to verify which workspace/dataset a document is linked to before publishing.

tools.name: manage_rebar_constraints
tools.description: Inspect/edit rebar constraints. Provide rebarId and action: list_handles | list_candidates (with handleIndex) | set_preferred (with handleIndex, candidateIndex) | remove_preferred (with handleIndex) | recompute (2025+). list_* actions are read-only.

action.description: Action: list_handles | list_candidates | set_preferred | remove_preferred | recompute

candidateIndex.description: Candidate index from action=list_candidates (required for set_preferred)

tools.name: duplicate_view
tools.description: Duplicate an existing view in Revit.

viewId.description: Element ID of the view to duplicate

tools.name: align_viewports
tools.description: Align viewports across sheets. 'placement' matches box centers; 'model' matches the box outline min-corner so equal-scale views of the same region line up.

targetViewportIds.description: Viewport IDs to align to the reference

alignMode.description: Alignment mode: placement | model. Default: placement

tools.name: list_rebar_splice_types
tools.description: List rebar splice types (Revit 2025+; returns a version error on older targets).

tools.name: create_rebar_from_curves
tools.description: Create a rebar from explicit coplanar curves (mm) in a host. curves is a JSON array of {type:line|arc, start{x,y,z}, end{x,y,z}, mid?{x,y,z}}; normal is JSON {x,y,z}. Optional hooks/layout.

curves.description: Curves JSON array of {type:line|arc, start{x,y,z}, end{x,y,z}, mid?{x,y,z}} in mm

barTypeName.description: Rebar bar type name (used if barTypeId omitted)

tools.name: create_surface_based_element
tools.description: Create surface-based elements (floors, ceilings). Pass a JSON array of creation specs: [{category, boundaryPoints:[{x,y,z}], typeName, levelId|levelName, ...}].

specs.description: JSON array of creation specs: [{category, boundaryPoints, typeName, levelId|levelName, ...}]

tools.name: batch_rename
tools.description: Batch rename elements or system types in the Revit project. Supports both loadable-family elements and system types (wall/floor/ceiling/roof types).

elementIds.description: Array of element IDs to rename. Use this when you already have specific IDs.

targetCategory.description: Target category to rename. Valid values: views | sheets | levels | grids | rooms | walltypes | floortypes | ceilingtypes | rooftypes. Use 'floortypes' to rename system floor types.

dryRun.description: Preview changes without applying

tools.name: select_from_powerbi
tools.description: Selects/zooms/isolates elements in the active Revit view from a Power BI drillthrough. Action: select | highlight | isolate.

elementIds.description: Element IDs to focus

action.description: Action: select | highlight | isolate. Default: select

tools.name: duplicate_sheet_with_views
tools.description: Duplicate a sheet N times with configurable view duplication options.

duplicateViews.description: Duplicate placed views as well. Default: true

keepLegends.description: Keep legends on the new sheets. Default: true

keepSchedules.description: Keep schedules on the new sheets. Default: true

newSheetNumberPrefix.description: Prefix applied to new sheet numbers

viewDuplicateOption.description: View duplicate option: Duplicate | DuplicateWithDetailing | DuplicateAsDependent. Default: DuplicateWithDetailing

tools.name: place_viewport
tools.description: Place a view on a sheet as a viewport, with optional rotation and viewport type.

positionX.description: X coordinate for viewport center, in mm

positionY.description: Y coordinate for viewport center, in mm

tools.description: Override element graphics in a view (colors, transparency, halftone, line weight).

elementIds.description: Element IDs to override

action.description: Action: set | reset. Default: set

viewId.description: View ID (optional; uses active view when 0)

tools.name: match_element_properties
tools.description: Copy parameter values from one source element to one or more target elements.

parameterNames.description: Parameter names to copy; if omitted, copies all writable parameters

includeTypeParameters.description: Also copy type-level parameters. Default: false

tools.name: audit_families
tools.description: Audit families in the Revit project. Lists loadable (.rfa) families by default; set includeSystemFamilies=true to also list system-family types (wall/floor/roof/ceiling types, including Foundation Slab).

categoryFilter.description: Filter by category (OST_* code, English friendly name, or localized display name)

includeUnused.description: Include unused families in the audit

includeSystemFamilies.description: Also enumerate system-family types (WallType/FloorType/RoofType/CeilingType). Default: false

sortBy.description: Sort order: instance_count | name. Default: instance_count

compact.description: Return compact family rows without audit booleans (isInPlace/isEditable/isUnused/kind). Default: false

tools.name: delete_material
tools.description: Delete a material from the project by ID or name.

tools.name: list_steel_connection_providers
tools.description: List installed structural connection providers. The public Revit API exposes no queryable provider registry; this returns count 0 with an explanatory note.

tools.name: add_steel_fabrication_info
tools.description: Add steel fabrication information to Revit elements so they participate in steel detailing (SteelElementProperties). Provide elementIds as a JSON array, e.g. [123,456]. Supports dryRun. Returns the ids that received fabrication info plus any skipped ids.

elementIds.description: JSON array of element ids, e.g. [123,456]

dryRun.description: Preview without writing. Default: true (preview); set false to execute.

tools.name: ifc_link

revitFilePath.description: Optional path to the companion .ifc.RVT (defaults to alongside the IFC)

recreateLink.description: Recreate the link if one already exists. Default: true

tools.description: Create a schedule from a predefined template (e.g. RoomFinish, DoorHardware, WallQuantities, WindowSchedule).

preset.description: Preset template name: RoomFinish, DoorHardware, WallQuantities, WindowSchedule

tools.name: get_structural_connection_validation_info
tools.description: Report validation detail for a placed structural connection (connectionId). No public API produces a populated ConnectionValidationInfo for an existing handler, so this returns the handler's CodeCheckingStatus and a note.

tools.name: pbi_create_dataset
tools.description: Creates a RevitCortex push dataset in a Power BI workspace. Idempotent: if a dataset with the same name already exists, returns its id without creating a duplicate. Default tables: Metadata, Elements, Selection.

tables.description: Tables to include. Allowed: Metadata, Elements, Schedules, ElementParameters, Selection. Default: [Metadata, Elements, Selection].

tools.name: set_rebar_visibility
tools.description: Set rebar view presentation. Provide rebarId, viewId, and unobscured (show in front of host).

unobscured.description: Show unobscured (in front of host). Default true

tools.name: get_fabric_sheet_data
tools.description: Read a fabric sheet: type id/name, isBent, fabricNumber, cut overall length and width (mm).

tools.name: get_material_properties
tools.description: Get detailed material properties (physical, thermal, appearance) by material ID or name.

tools.name: create_material
tools.description: Create a new material in the Revit project.

tools.name: get_rebar_constraints
tools.description: List the constrained handles of a rebar and whether its constraints can be edited.

tools.name: set_fabric_sheet_bend_profile
tools.description: Set the bend profile of a bent fabric sheet. Provide fabricSheetId and bendProfile (a JSON array of {type:line|arc, start{x,y,z}, end{x,y,z}, mid?{x,y,z}} in mm forming a closed loop). Only valid when the sheet is bent.

bendProfile.description: Bend profile JSON array of {type:line|arc, start{x,y,z}, end{x,y,z}, mid?{x,y,z}} in mm forming a closed loop

tools.name: get_current_view_info
tools.description: Get information about the currently active view in Revit.

tools.name: purge_unused
tools.description: Purge unused families/types and materials, and optionally unreferenced view templates and view filters, from the project.

includeFilters.description: Also purge view filters not applied to any view. Default: true

tools.name: rename_families
tools.description: Rename loaded families (and optionally their types) with find/replace, prefix, or suffix operations.

operation.description: Operation: prefix | suffix | findReplace. Default: prefix

categories.description: Categories to restrict the rename (e.g. Doors, Windows)

renameTypes.description: Also rename the family types. Default: false

dryRun.description: Preview without writing. Default: true

tools.description: Report a StructuralConnectionType's applicability hints. Revit exposes no public 'does this type apply to these elements' predicate, so this returns the type's ApplyTo + family symbol id and, for any supplied elementIds, their categories — clearly labelled as advisory.

tools.description: Set editable Project Information fields. Only the fields you pass are changed; others are left untouched.

tools.description: Set the code-checking status of a structural connection handler. status = NotCalculated | OkChecked | CheckingFailed.

tools.description: List available family types in the Revit project.
